planets.name: TOI-5398 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5398 with a 4.77-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-5398 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-5398. Its orbit and size follow Mantovan et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
